# The Art Story

> > Comprehensive modern art history resource covering movements, artists, and visual analysis from Impressionism to Abstract Expressionism.

The Art Story Foundation provides in-depth educational content on modern art movements and influential artists including Mark Rothko, Jackson Pollock, Gustave Courbet, and others. The site features detailed artist biographies, movement overviews, image comparisons, and timelines designed for students, educators, and art professionals.

## Key Topics

- Modern Art
- Art Movements
- Abstract Expressionism
- Impressionism
- Realism
- Mark Rothko
- Jackson Pollock
- Gustave Courbet
- Art History Education
- Image Comparison
- Art Timeline
- Art Nouveau
- Visual Analysis
- Artist Biographies
- Art Theory

## Essential Resources

- [The Art Story: Visual Art Movements, Artists, Ideas and Topics](https://www.theartstory.org): Homepage: Visual art history covering movements, artists like Picasso, Warhol
- [The 7 Most Important Modern Artists](https://www.theartstory.org/top7.htm): Top 7 modern artists: Monet, Van Gogh, Picasso, Duchamp, Dalí featured
- [Modern Art Top 50 Timeline](https://www.theartstory.org/top50.htm): Timeline of top 50 modern artworks from 1850 to 1970

## For Educators and Professionals

- [For Educators](https://www.theartstory.org/educators.htm): Educational resources and teaching tools for art history instructors
- [For Art Professionals](https://www.theartstory.org/professionals.htm): Resources for gallery owners, appraisers, and art professionals

## Visual Analysis and Comparisons

- [Image Comparison - Matisse vs. Ingres: Tradition](https://www.theartstory.org/comparison-matisse-1.htm): Visual comparison of Matisse and Ingres exploring classical tradition
- [Rothko vs. Titian: Color and Spirituality](https://www.theartstory.org/comparison-rothko-mark-3.htm): Rothko and Titian comparison exploring color theory and spirituality
- [Image Comparison - Courbet vs. David: Composition](https://www.theartstory.org/comparison-courbet-2.htm): Courbet vs David compositional analysis comparing Realism and Neoclassicism
- [Image Comparison: Courbet vs. Bouguereau: The Fantastic](https://www.theartstory.org/comparison-courbet-4.htm): Courbet vs Bouguereau: contrasting Realism with academic fantasy painting

## Artist and Gallery Profiles

- [Mark Rothko Jewish Achievements Overview](https://www.theartstory.org/jewish-artist-rothko-mark.htm): Mark Rothko's work analyzed through Jewish heritage and identity themes
- [The Leo Castelli Gallery](https://www.theartstory.org/gallery-castelli-leo.htm): Leo Castelli Gallery history: Pop Art, Minimalism, Abstract Expressionism

- [Student Ambassador Program](https://www.theartstory.org/ambassadors.htm): Student Ambassador Program for art writing and marketing experience

- [Donate to the Art Story Foundation](https://www.theartstory.org/donate.htm): Support Art Story Foundation's mission to expand modern art appreciation
- [Partnership](https://www.theartstory.org/partner.htm): Partnership and sponsorship opportunities with Art Story Foundation
